title: Getting started: QC of a Mad4hatter run
text: package includes simulated run MAD4HatTeR panel, run Mad4hatter’s --pools D1,R1,R2. D1 R1 amplified one mPCR reaction R2 second. run two batches, 96-well plate 2 positive controls (3D7) 2 negative controls. Batch1 fills plate 92 samples; Batch2 84 samples column 12 left empty. data simulated real MAD4HatTeR panel information, target names, pools target lengths match real run. manifest describes well:
code: library(ampseqQC) library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE)  tutorial_dir <- system.file("extdata", "tutorial", package = "ampseqQC") results_dir <- file.path(tutorial_dir, "results") manifest_file <- file.path(tutorial_dir, "manifest.csv")  list.files(results_dir, recursive = TRUE) #> [1] "allele_data.txt"                     "amplicon_coverage.txt"               #> [3] "panel_information/amplicon_info.tsv" "sample_coverage.txt" manifest <- read_manifest(manifest_file) head(manifest) #>   sample_name SampleType  Batch Column Row Parasitemia #> 1      B1_S01     sample Batch1      1   A      6788.9 #> 2      B1_S02     sample Batch1      1   B         1.3 #> 3      B1_S03     sample Batch1      1   C        11.1 #> 4      B1_S04     sample Batch1      1   D       453.2 #> 5      B1_S05     sample Batch1      1   E     16954.5 #> 6      B1_S06     sample Batch1      1   F     39949.5 count(manifest, Batch, SampleType) #>    Batch SampleType  n #> 1 Batch1   negative  2 #> 2 Batch1   positive  2 #> 3 Batch1     sample 92 #> 4 Batch2   negative  2 #> 5 Batch2   positive  2 #> 6 Batch2     sample 84

title: Getting started: QC of a Mad4hatter run
text: pools run read panel information mapped reactions using panel settings. defaults cover MAD4HatTeR PfPHAST pools: Targets shared pools different reactions counted reaction. run two targets R1 R2: run uses pools aren’t settings, different reaction layout, add panel_settings(). Pools without reaction stop QC rather guessed:
code: default_panel_settings() #> <ampseqQC panel settings> #> Pool -> reaction: #>   1: D1, D1.1, 1A, R1, R1.1, R1.2, 1B, 5, M1, M1.1, M1.addon #>   2: R2, R2.1, 2, M2, M2.1 #> Targets excluded from QC: 14 summarise_pools(results$panel_information) #> # A tibble: 3 × 3 #>   pool  reaction n_targets #>   <chr> <chr>        <int> #> 1 D1    1              170 #> 2 R1    1               47 #> 3 R2    2               31 panel_reactions <- assign_reactions(results$panel_information) panel_reactions |>   count(target_name) |>   filter(n > 1) #>                   target_name n #> 1 Pf3D7_13_v3-2841410-2841661 2 #> 2 Pf3D7_13_v3-2844354-2844599 2 bespoke_panel <- results$panel_information |>   mutate(pool = ifelse(pool == "R2", "myPool", pool)) assign_reactions(bespoke_panel) #> Error: #> ! No reaction is defined for pool(s): myPool. #> Supply the reaction for each pool with panel_settings(), e.g. panel_settings(c("myPool" = "1"), base = default_panel_settings())  settings <- panel_settings(c(myPool = "2"), base = default_panel_settings()) assign_reactions(bespoke_panel, settings) |>   count(reaction) #>   reaction   n #> 1        1 214 #> 2        2  31

title: Getting started: QC of a Mad4hatter run
text: Samples classified per reaction: reprep_threshold targets amplified need re-prep, repool_threshold need re-pool. Samples manifest data marked reprep. Negative controls classified. things stand . Low-parasitemia samples fail reactions. B2_S05 B2_S06 amplified well reaction 1 reaction 2, points problem reaction 2 mPCR wells rather samples. B2_S20 manifest data, sequenced. overall pass rate batch excludes controls:  Plate maps show samples controls plate, help spot problems particular wells regions plate. Empty wells, column 12 Batch2 plate, shown black:
code: qc_calls <- generate_reprep_repool_table(summary_samples, reprep_threshold = 0.5, repool_threshold = 0.75) |>   fill_missing_data(manifest)  qc_calls |>   filter(status != "pass") |>   arrange(Batch, sample_name, reaction) #> # A tibble: 68 × 8 #>    sample_name Batch  SampleType reaction status reason       reads_per_reaction #>    <chr>       <chr>  <chr>      <chr>    <chr>  <chr>                     <dbl> #>  1 B1_S02      Batch1 sample     1        reprep < reprep th…              13661 #>  2 B1_S02      Batch1 sample     2        reprep < reprep th…               1692 #>  3 B1_S03      Batch1 sample     1        repool < repool th…              30071 #>  4 B1_S03      Batch1 sample     2        repool < repool th…               3535 #>  5 B1_S12      Batch1 sample     1        reprep < reprep th…              16866 #>  6 B1_S12      Batch1 sample     2        reprep < reprep th…               1871 #>  7 B1_S20      Batch1 sample     1        reprep < reprep th…              15019 #>  8 B1_S20      Batch1 sample     2        reprep < reprep th…               1751 #>  9 B1_S24      Batch1 sample     1        reprep < reprep th…               9005 #> 10 B1_S24      Batch1 sample     2        reprep < reprep th…                947 #> # ℹ 58 more rows #> # ℹ 1 more variable: prop_good_loci <dbl> qc_summary_table(qc_calls) #> # A tibble: 2 × 6 #>   Batch   pass repool reprep total pass_rate #>   <chr>  <int>  <int>  <int> <int>     <dbl> #> 1 Batch1    79      3     10    92      85.9 #> 2 Batch2    66      9     16    91      72.5 qc_summary_by_batch(qc_calls) |>   plot_qc_status_by_batch() quadrants <- create_plate_template(summary_samples, unique(summary_samples$Batch)) plot_plate_layouts(quadrants)$Batch2 plot_plate_heat_maps(   summary_samples, quadrants,   fill_param = "prop_good_loci", scale_midpoint = 0.5, scale_label = "prop_good_loci" )$Batch2

title: Quality Control Reports for Mad4hatter Amplicon Sequencing Runs
text: results directory Mad4hatter pipeline must include: sample_coverage.txt amplicon_coverage.txt allele_data.txt panel_information/amplicon_info.tsv present, allele_data_collapsed.txt resistance_marker_module tables also filtered written . sample manifest (comma semicolon separated) must contain: sample_name – Unique identifier sample. SampleType – Specifies whether entry sample, positive control, negative control. Batch – Identifies group samples processed simultaneously individual. Column – well column sample placed plate. Row – well row sample placed plate. Parasitemia – qPCR value sample.

title: Quality Control Reports for Mad4hatter Amplicon Sequencing Runs
text: pools run read pool column panel_information/amplicon_info.tsv, combination subset pools supported. Panel settings map pool mPCR reaction amplified , list targets exclude QC calculations (still kept filtered allele tables). default_panel_settings() covers MAD4HatTeR PfPHAST pools, including versioned legacy names, using recommended two-reaction layout: Targets shared pools different reactions counted reaction. run contains pool reaction defined, report stops asks one. Use panel_settings() add pools change layout:
code: # Add a bespoke pool panel <- panel_settings(c(AMPLseq = "3"), base = default_panel_settings())  # R1.2 run in its own reaction panel <- panel_settings(c(R1 = "3", R1.2 = "3"), base = default_panel_settings())  render_qc_report("path/to/results", "path/to/manifest.csv", panel = panel)

title: Quality Control Reports for Mad4hatter Amplicon Sequencing Runs
text: QC steps exported, can used outside report, example:
code: results <- read_mad4hatter_results("path/to/results") manifest <- read_manifest("path/to/manifest.csv")  excluded <- qc_excluded_targets(results$panel_information) panel_reactions <- assign_reactions(results$panel_information) |>   dplyr::filter(!target_name %in% excluded$excluded) amplicon_coverage_qc <- results$amplicon_coverage |>   dplyr::filter(!target_name %in% excluded$excluded)  summary_samples <- summarise_samples(   merge_amplicon_coverage(amplicon_coverage_qc, manifest, panel_reactions),   count_targets_per_reaction(panel_reactions),   manifest,   read_threshold = 100 ) qc_calls <- generate_reprep_repool_table(summary_samples) |>   fill_missing_data(manifest)
